mcp_live_tools.name: ai_tools
mcp_live_tools.summary: List supported AI-first MCP tools plus manifest-backed metadata.

mcp_live_tools.name: generate_config
mcp_live_tools.summary: Generate deterministic, safe-default config for agent runs.

mcp_live_tools.name: review_config
mcp_live_tools.summary: Review agent config JSON and return issues/warnings.

mcp_live_tools.name: doctor
mcp_live_tools.summary: Run yolozu doctor and return JSON payload + short summary.

mcp_live_tools.name: validate_predictions
mcp_live_tools.summary: Validate strictly, or explicitly repair with strict=false.

examples.description: Emit a bounded machine-readable validation result.

mcp_live_tools.name: validate_dataset
mcp_live_tools.summary: Validate YOLO-format dataset.

mcp_live_tools.name: eval_coco
mcp_live_tools.summary: Evaluate predictions strictly unless repair is explicitly enabled.

examples.description: Strict dry-run validation and conversion without pycocotools.
Explicitly repair legacy ranges and record every repair in warnings.

writes.description: Atomically writes a status=ok COCO report or replaces stale success evidence with a status=failed report.

requires.notes: Required for real COCOeval only; --dry-run performs strict validation/conversion without pycocotools.

mcp_live_tools.name: predict_images
mcp_live_tools.summary: Run folder inference and write predictions JSON.

mcp_live_tools.name: recommend_image_pipeline
mcp_live_tools.summary: Recommend a qualified local image pipeline without executing it.

examples.command: Call the recommend_image_pipeline MCP tool with a structured job_spec and one workspace-relative input_path.
examples.description: Return a selected or abstained SelectionDecision without model execution, downloads, network access, or writes.

mcp_live_tools.name: process_images
mcp_live_tools.summary: Revalidate and optionally execute one pinned selected image pipeline.

examples.command: Call the process_images MCP tool with job_spec, the complete selected SelectionDecision, workspace-relative input_path/output_dir, and dry_run=true.
examples.description: Revalidate the pinned selection and all local state without importing or calling a runner or writing output.

examples.command: Call the process_images MCP tool again with the same pinned inputs and dry_run=false after reviewing the preflight result.
examples.description: Execute only the selected registered code-owned route and publish the bounded managed output tree.

writes.description: On explicit dry_run=false, atomically publishes only predictions.json, provenance.json, checksums.json, and referenced masks below output_dir.

mcp_live_tools.name: parity_check
mcp_live_tools.summary: Compare two predictions JSON files for parity.

mcp_live_tools.name: calibrate_predictions
mcp_live_tools.summary: Apply post-hoc calibration to prediction scores.

mcp_live_tools.name: eval_instance_seg
mcp_live_tools.summary: Evaluate instance segmentation predictions.

mcp_live_tools.name: eval_long_tail
mcp_live_tools.summary: Evaluate long-tail detection metrics.

mcp_live_tools.name: run_scenarios
mcp_live_tools.summary: Run scenarios with declared long-form scenario flags only.

examples.description: Run a basic dummy scenario pass.

mcp_live_tools.name: convert_dataset
mcp_live_tools.summary: Convert external dataset layout into YOLOZU descriptor via migrate dataset.

mcp_live_tools.name: train_job
mcp_live_tools.summary: Queue train command as asynchronous job and return job_id.

mcp_live_tools.name: export_predictions_job
mcp_live_tools.summary: Queue predictions export command as asynchronous job and return job_id.

mcp_live_tools.name: export_onnx_job
mcp_live_tools.summary: Compatibility alias for export_predictions_job_tool.

mcp_live_tools.name: test_job
mcp_live_tools.summary: Queue a test using declared long-form scenario flags only.

mcp_live_tools.name: ttt_job
mcp_live_tools.summary: Queue a local TTT export diagnostic and return its asynchronous job_id.

mcp_live_tools.name: ctta_job
mcp_live_tools.summary: Queue a local continual-TTA export diagnostic and return its job_id.

mcp_live_tools.summary: List jobs.

mcp_live_tools.name: jobs_status
mcp_live_tools.summary: Get status for one job.

mcp_live_tools.name: jobs_cancel
mcp_live_tools.summary: Cancel one job if possible.

mcp_live_tools.summary: List run directories and metadata.
